name: MSME Business Support
description: Financial and business support opportunities for eligible micro, small and medium enterprises.
overview: This scheme category provides support opportunities for eligible micro, small and medium enterprises. Businesses may receive different forms of assistance depending on the applicable government programme and eligibility conditions.

benefits.title: Financial Support
benefits.description: Eligible businesses may receive financial assistance under applicable programmes.

benefits.title: Business Assistance
benefits.description: Support may be available for business development and expansion.

benefits.title: Growth Opportunities
benefits.description: Government programmes can help eligible businesses access development opportunities.

eligibility: Registered micro, small or medium enterprise
Valid business registration or Udyam registration
Investment within the applicable MSME limits
process: Confirm your business meets the eligibility conditions
Prepare the required registration and financial documents
Submit the application to the concerned department
Track the application and respond to any queries raised

name: Startup Support Program
description: Support programmes designed to encourage entrepreneurship, innovation and development of new businesses.
overview: Startup support programmes may provide assistance for eligible new businesses, innovation activities and entrepreneurship development.

benefits.title: Startup Support
benefits.description: Eligible startups may receive support for business development.

benefits.title: Innovation
benefits.description: Programmes may support innovative ideas and technology.

benefits.title: Business Growth
benefits.description: Support can help startups develop and expand their operations.

eligibility: Working on an innovative product, process or service
Within the turnover limits set by the programme
Not formed by splitting up an existing business
process: Check that the business meets the startup definition
Prepare the incorporation and innovation documents
Submit the application with the supporting write-up
Respond to any clarification sought by the department

name: Technology Development Support
description: Opportunities supporting technology adoption, digital transformation and business modernization.
overview: Technology development programmes may support eligible businesses in adopting digital tools, improving processes and modernizing their operations.

benefits.title: Technology Support
benefits.description: Support may be available for technology adoption.

benefits.title: Modernization
benefits.description: Businesses may improve operational processes using technology.

benefits.title: Digital Growth
benefits.description: Technology adoption can support business development.

eligibility: Operational business with a registered unit
Proposed technology upgrade or modernization plan
Applicable to manufacturing and processing units
process: Obtain quotations for the proposed machinery or software
Submit the application with the project report
Track the application and provide any further details sought

name: Business Credit Assistance
description: Financing-related assistance for eligible businesses to support expansion and working capital requirements.
overview: Credit assistance programmes may help eligible businesses access financing for expansion, working capital and other approved business requirements.

benefits.title: Credit Assistance
benefits.description: Eligible businesses may access financing support.

benefits.title: Financial Access
benefits.description: Programmes may improve access to business finance.

benefits.title: Business Expansion
benefits.description: Financing can support eligible expansion activities.

eligibility: Registered business with an operating history or a viable project
Clearly defined end-use for the credit sought
Required approvals in place or applied for
process: Prepare the project report and financial statements
Approach the lending institution with the application
Provide the requested business and financial documents
Track the application through to sanction
